query:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_sessions WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game_id = ?2)
                    AS "game!: i64",
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_sessions WHERE user_id = ?1
                     AND created_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-1 day'))
                    AS "today!: i64"
